title: MV Looking to make a Battle HUD! [ RPG MAKER MV]

posts.author: Looperdooper
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Hud Anims
Maker Format:
RPG Maker MV
Makers I Own:
RPG Maker MV
Description:
Hi! I'm looking to make a HUD similar to how this one in the video below is made. I've already made the pieces for my stylized HUD though I'm not sure if I'll keep it as the design it is in my game.
Anyways, what I'm looking to replicate are FNAFB's HUDs animations such as:
-The little character shake when the current player is hurt
-The light glow around the current player
-The action box moving above the current player.
-Finally just the images transitions into moving on the screen when selecting (skills, items, so on as shown in video)
I am having a bit of trouble learning Java script for the scripting part of my game and would like to know any good resources that you all could recommend for learning such. Thank you, I appreciate anyone who can help me.
(Btw, I have learned a bit of SRD Hud Maker for this and maybe there is more to learn to it?)
Reference Images:

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: You could use moghunter's battle hud plugin. There's one template that has pretty much all the functionality you want, you'd just have to either replace the png files with the style you want, or disable the individual ones you want to use your default window skin on.

posts.author: Erif
posts.body: A second vote for MOG's hud. It's pretty much the Xillia/Mini template.
